svg.title: ASS2-0P5 die bonding and NFC winding
svg.desc: Top view of the PCB landing fingers and all wirebonds. The four-turn coil and inner crossover are shown at a separate scale.
svg.text: 1.936 × 2.531 mm die / 60 × 60 µm Metal5 terminal windows
40 × 40 mm / 4 turns / 0.42 mm track / 0.56 mm gap
Blue ground · Red +5 V · Gray unbonded analog
South 3 and 4 each use two sites and two fingers. Nine capped vias under EP.
Blue copper exits the inner turn on L4. Winding and die use separate scales.
